analysis_md:
解答 $\Sigma$ 围成球体 $\Omega$，用高斯公式

$$\oiint_\Sigma xy^2dydz+yz^2dzdx+zx^2dxdy=\iiint_\Omega(y^2+z^2+x^2)dv=\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^\pi\sin\varphi\,d\varphi\int_0^1r^4dr=2\pi\cdot2\cdot\frac{1}{5}=\frac{4}{5}\pi$$
